name: check_room
description: Checks whether a room can be booked for a requested time slot and returns only an Available or Unavailable decision. All times are whole minutes since midnight, in the range 0 to 1440. This tool does not save, create or change any booking; it only checks the request against the existing bookings and rules.

start.description: Requested start time in minutes since midnight.

end.description: Requested end time in minutes since midnight, after start.

now.description: Current time in minutes since midnight.

blocked.description: True if the room is blocked and cannot accept any booking.

bookings.description: Existing bookings of the room, each with a start and an end in minutes since midnight.
